name: Sporthotel Achensee
beschreibung: The Familienparadies Sporthotel Achensee is a family-run 4-star hotel in Achenkirch on Lake Achensee in the Tyrolean Karwendel. The Hlebaina family's hotel is one of the leading children's hotels in Europe and specialises in holidays with babies, children and teenagers. The facilities include an indoor pool, an extensive wellness oasis with saunas, massages and a water world, as well as a hotel sports shop with a rental service. The ski lifts are right on the doorstep, and the cross-country ski trail entrance is at the hotel's own Seealm. An in-house ski school offers courses for children aged three and over. The restaurant spoils guests with all-inclusive catering, and for the youngest guests there is a separate buffet and supervised children's programmes.
